field.description: Irrigated field: paddocks under crops on a layered soil, each ordering water to meet its deficit

evap.description: Reference evapotranspiration [mm], the reference the kc values were derived for

efficiency.description: Share of supply that reaches the soil; the rest is escape, which leaves the model (default 1)

interception.description: Rain reaches the soil only beyond this fraction of the day's evap; the rest is intercepted and lost (default 0.2, FAO-56)

return_fraction.description: Share of the runoff (excess) the farm catches: it leaves on ds_2 as return_flow, the rest on ds_1 with the bypass (default 0)

initial_depletion.description: How far below full every layer of the soil starts, over the whole profile [mm], default 0

curve_number.description: USDA-NRCS curve number (CN2, average antecedent condition) for storm runoff off the paddock surface; omitted, rain runs off only when the profile is full. Daily steps only

available_water.description: Water the soil holds between full and empty, per metre of soil [mm/m]

crop_1_order.description: The irrigation rule for crop_1, in ML; omitted, the crop is rain-fed

crop_1_viable_area.description: Each day in the ground, crop_1's area becomes min(area, value) [km2]; 0 is death. Omitted, a crop whose stress coefficient starts the day at 0.05 or below dies

crop_1_kc_multiplier.description: Scales crop_1's kc in the evapotranspiration step only, read every day the crop stands; interception is unaffected. Omitted, 1
